summary: Complete initial independent audit of all 208 Chinese source units, all 34 temporal or active-hint items, and all ten people. The chapter's dated Taiwan chronology supports the remaining claims and their year-level conversions. Two source-specific uncertainties prevent approval: Zheng Jing's undated renaming of Eastern Capital cannot be stretched into AD 1661–1683 activity from the later 1683 Taiwan pacification, and the 1887 Yang–Liu memorial's reference to former governor Cen Yuying does not date Cen's earlier proposal. Those two claims, their derived hints, and their person checks are retained as research holds; no source or canonical extraction was changed.
